My work

Self-Updating Knowledge Base

n8n
The problem

Everything the team knows is scattered across chat threads, PDFs and voice notes. The same questions get asked and answered over and over, and useful detail dies in somebody's inbox.

What it solves

Everything the team knows becomes one thing you can simply ask. Text, PDFs, voice notes and images each run down their own processing branch into a vector store, and the bot answers against the lot — so knowledge gets added by forwarding a message, not by writing documentation.

4 input typesVector store + RAGAI agent Q&A
Overview

A Telegram-fed knowledge base that turns forwarded text, PDFs, voice notes and images into one store the team can simply ask questions of.

How it works
  1. A message, PDF, voice note or image is sent to the Telegram bot
  2. The workflow sorts it by message type and sends it down its own processing branch
  3. The content is converted to embeddings and saved to a vector store
  4. Anyone on the team asks a question and an AI agent answers from everything stored
Key features
  • 4 input types: text, PDFs, voice notes and images
  • Vector store with retrieval (RAG)
  • AI agent Q&A
  • Knowledge is added by forwarding a message
Tools used
  • n8n
  • Telegram
  • Embeddings + vector store
  • AI agent
Purpose

To make everything the team knows instantly askable, without anyone writing documentation.

Searchable Call Transcripts

Make.com
The problem

A call recording is only useful to whoever was on the call. Anyone else has to replay it to find one detail, and nothing inside an audio file is searchable.

What it solves

Nobody replays a call to find one detail again. Each recording is transcribed with Whisper, filed against the right Airtable record and posted to Slack moments after the call ends, so the account history is readable, searchable and shared with whoever picks the client up next.

Whisper + Airtable6 ops per run~4s end to end
Overview

A Make.com scenario that transcribes each call recording with Whisper, files the transcript against the right Airtable record and posts it to Slack.

How it works
  1. A webhook fires when a call recording is ready
  2. An iterator handles each recording
  3. The audio file is downloaded
  4. Whisper transcribes the recording
  5. The transcript is saved to the matching Airtable record and posted to Slack
Key features
  • Whisper transcription
  • Filed against the right Airtable record
  • Slack notification
  • 6 operations per run, about 4 seconds end to end
Tools used
  • Make.com
  • Whisper
  • Airtable
  • Slack
Purpose

To make every call searchable and shared, so nobody has to replay a recording to find one detail.

Make.com

Five-Touch Nurture Sequence

GoHighLevel
The problem

Most leads need several follow-ups before they book, but manual follow-up runs out of steam after one or two — and the effort gets spread evenly across every lead, including the ones that were never going to qualify. The ones who do book often keep getting chased anyway.

What it solves

Every lead gets five follow-ups, and only the ones worth working get them. A qualification gate sorts each submission first — time in business and the rest of the criteria. Leads that pass are routed by service type, given their own opportunity and worked with daily email and SMS booking asks; leads that fail are marked Not Qualified rather than chased, with Credit Repair redirected into the nurture path since it does not need the same criteria. The pipeline is checked between every touch, so anyone who books stops hearing from you immediately and anyone still quiet at the end is tagged Lost Lead.

Qualification gate5 email + SMS touches3 service branches
Overview

A GoHighLevel lead-nurturing workflow that qualifies each new submission, routes it by service type and follows up with five email and SMS booking asks.

How it works
  1. A form submission triggers the workflow
  2. A qualification gate checks time in business and the other criteria
  3. Leads that pass are routed to one of three service branches and given their own opportunity; leads that fail are marked Not Qualified
  4. Daily email and SMS booking asks go out, with the pipeline checked between every touch
  5. Anyone who books stops receiving messages; anyone still quiet at the end is tagged Lost Lead
Key features
  • Qualification gate
  • 5 email + SMS touches
  • 3 service branches
  • Booked-a-call checks between touches
  • Not Qualified and Lost Lead tagging
Tools used
  • GoHighLevel workflows
  • Email + SMS
  • Pipelines + opportunities
  • Tags
Purpose

To give every worthwhile lead consistent follow-up until they book, without manual chasing.

Instant Contract Dispatch

GoHighLevel
The problem

Contracts only go out once somebody notices the deal has moved. On a busy day that is hours later, and with three pipelines running side by side it is easy to send the wrong agreement — or to send it and leave the rest of the team assuming it still has not gone.

What it solves

The right contract leaves the moment a deal reaches its contract stage, without anyone watching the board. Each pipeline has its own trigger — Business Funding and Personal Funding on Contract Sent, Credit Repair on its Agreement & Intake stage — and a single condition reads which one fired, so the branch that runs sends that pipeline’s own document template and nothing else. An internal notification follows every send, so the team sees the contract is out rather than asking. Anything that matches none of the three stops at an end step instead of guessing at paperwork.

3 pipelines, 1 workflowTemplate per pipelineInternal notification on send
Overview

One GoHighLevel workflow that sends the right contract the moment a deal reaches its contract stage in any of three pipelines.

How it works
  1. A deal reaches its contract stage in the Business Funding, Personal Funding or Credit Repair pipeline
  2. A single condition reads which pipeline fired
  3. That branch sends its own document template
  4. An internal notification tells the team the contract is out
  5. Anything that matches none of the three stops at an end step
Key features
  • 3 pipelines, 1 workflow
  • Template per pipeline
  • Internal notification on send
  • Safe stop for unmatched deals
Tools used
  • GoHighLevel
  • Pipeline stage triggers
  • Documents + Contracts
  • Internal notifications
Purpose

To get the correct agreement to every client immediately, with nobody watching the board.

Signature-to-Invoice Handoff

GoHighLevel
The problem

A signed contract comes back and then sits. Someone has to spot the signature, work out which product it was for, drag the card to the next stage and tell whoever raises the invoice. Until all four of those happen the deal still reads as unsigned, and billing starts days after the client committed.

What it solves

Billing starts the minute the client signs, not the next time someone checks the inbox. The workflow fires on the document itself as soon as its status turns Completed and reads the template it was created from, so a signed Business Funding, Personal Funding or Credit Repair agreement each runs down its own branch. That branch creates or moves the client’s opportunity straight to the sent-invoice stage and posts an internal notification, so the person who raises invoices finds out without being told. A completed document matching none of the three ends quietly rather than pushing the wrong deal forward.

Fires on signatureMatched on template IDOpportunity moved automatically
Overview

A GoHighLevel workflow that fires the moment a contract is signed and moves the deal straight to the sent-invoice stage.

How it works
  1. A document's status turns Completed
  2. A condition reads the template the document was created from
  3. The matching branch (Business Funding, Personal Funding or Credit Repair) creates or moves the opportunity to the sent-invoice stage
  4. An internal notification tells whoever raises the invoice
  5. A completed document that matches none of the three ends quietly
Key features
  • Fires on signature
  • Matched on template ID
  • Opportunity moved automatically
  • Internal notification
Tools used
  • GoHighLevel
  • Documents + Contracts trigger
  • Pipelines + opportunities
  • Internal notifications

To start billing the minute the client signs.

Right Invoice, Every Time

GoHighLevel
The problem

Invoicing by hand after a deal moves is where money quietly goes missing. The wrong product’s invoice goes out, or a second copy of one already sent because the card was dragged twice, or nothing at all because the product field was never filled in — and the first anyone hears of it is the client querying the bill.

What it solves

Every client gets the invoice for the product they actually bought, exactly once. A tag check runs before anything else, so a deal that moves stage twice is recognised as already invoiced and stops there. Product type then decides which of the five invoices is sent — Engagement Fee, Standard, Expedient or Rapid Credit Restoration, or Real Estate Advisory — and the contact is tagged invoice-sent on the way out. When the product type is missing the flow refuses to guess: it tags the contact missing-product-type, moves the opportunity back to the contract stage where somebody owns it, and waits for the field to be filled. As soon as it is, the tag clears itself, the invoice goes, and the opportunity moves to Invoice Sent on its own.

5 product invoicesDuplicate-send guardSelf-clearing missing-field loop
Overview

A GoHighLevel workflow that sends the correct product invoice exactly once and handles a missing product type safely.

How it works
  1. A pipeline stage change triggers the workflow
  2. A tag check runs first, so a deal already invoiced stops there
  3. Product type decides which of the five invoices is sent
  4. The invoice goes out and the contact is tagged invoice-sent
  5. If the product type is missing, the contact is tagged missing-product-type and the opportunity moves back to the contract stage; once the field is filled the tag clears, the invoice is sent and the opportunity moves to Invoice Sent
Key features
  • 5 product invoices
  • Duplicate-send guard
  • Self-clearing missing-field loop
  • Opportunity moves to Invoice Sent automatically
Tools used
  • GoHighLevel
  • Pipeline stage triggers
  • Tags + conditions
  • Invoices
Purpose

To make sure every client is billed for the right product, exactly once.

Never-Missed Benchmark Calls

GoHighLevel
The problem

Walking clients through a run of scheduled check-in calls is relentless admin. Reminders get skipped on the weeks the team is busiest, clients who already did their call get chased anyway, and the ones who quietly dropped off are only noticed long after the point where a nudge would have helped.

What it solves

Every client is walked through their benchmark calls without anyone tracking it on a spreadsheet, and nobody who has already done one gets chased. The flow starts from the appointment itself, branches on what actually happened to it, and assigns the contact to the right team member before any reminder goes out. From there it works through the stages one at a time, and each stage checks that client’s completion tag before it does anything — still outstanding and they get an SMS followed by an email, already done and that branch simply ends. Clients only climb to the next stage as they complete the one before, so a reminder never arrives for a call they have already had.

Appointment-triggeredTag-gated stagesSMS + email per stage
Overview

A GoHighLevel reminder flow that walks clients through a series of benchmark calls, starting from the appointment itself.

How it works
  1. An appointment triggers the flow
  2. After a wait, the flow branches on what happened to the appointment
  3. The contact is assigned to the right team member
  4. Each stage checks that client's completion tag
  5. If the call is still outstanding, an SMS and then an email go out; if it is already done, that branch ends and the client moves up to the next stage
Key features
  • Appointment-triggered
  • Tag-gated stages
  • SMS + email per stage
  • No reminders for calls already completed
Tools used
  • GoHighLevel workflows
  • Appointments
  • Tags
  • SMS + email
Purpose

To keep every client on track through their benchmark calls without tracking it on a spreadsheet.

Caller-Verifying Voice Agent

GHL Voice AI
The problem

A phone agent that cannot tell a lead from a client is worse than no agent at all. It greets a webinar registrant like a customer, reads back a status that is not theirs, or asks a long-standing client for details already on file — and every call still has to be typed into the CRM afterwards.

What it solves

Callers only hear their real status, and only once the agent knows who it is talking to. The number is matched against the CRM, so a known caller is greeted by first name and asked to confirm what is on file rather than repeat it, while a new caller is taken through name, number and email with each one read back. A contact match is explicitly not treated as proof of being a client — the agent asks outright, then pulls the live record through a custom action and reads the deal name and submission status exactly as returned, never a guess. From there it books the appointment or hands the call to a person, and when the call ends it writes the corrected name, phone and email back onto the contact.

Identity check before disclosureLive status lookup mid-callBooks, transfers, writes back
Overview

A GoHighLevel Voice AI agent that confirms who is calling before it shares any status, then books, transfers and updates the CRM.

How it works
  1. The caller's number is matched against the CRM
  2. A known caller is greeted by first name and confirms what is on file; a new caller gives name, number and email, each read back
  3. The agent asks outright whether the caller is a client, because a contact match is not treated as proof
  4. A custom action pulls the live record and the agent reads the deal name and submission status exactly as returned
  5. It books the appointment or transfers the call to a person
  6. After the call, the corrected name, phone and email are written back to the contact
Key features
  • Identity check before disclosure
  • Live status lookup mid-call
  • Books appointments and transfers calls
  • Writes back to the contact after the call
Tools used
  • GoHighLevel Voice AI
  • Get Client Status custom action
  • Appointment booking + call transfer
  • CRM contact fields
Purpose

To give every caller accurate answers about their own status, without a person on the phone.

Same-Minute Client Onboarding

GHL + Zapier + Airtable
The problem

Between a client paying and somebody setting their account up there is a gap nobody owns. The client has just handed over money, hears nothing, and starts wondering what they bought — and when a step quietly fails, nobody finds out until the client asks.

What it solves

Clients are welcomed within a minute of paying, every time. Reaching the paid stage in any of the three pipelines hands the contact to Zapier, which creates their LaunchBay portal, writes the project ID and portal URL to Airtable, posts back to GoHighLevel and fires the welcome SMS and email. Every branch is checked rather than assumed: a missing project ID, a missing Airtable record, or a post that does not come back successful each raise their own alert instead of failing silently.

3 workflows3 client pathsError alerts on failure
Overview

A three-workflow automation that welcomes every paying client within a minute by creating their portal and sending the welcome messages.

How it works
  1. A deal reaches the paid stage in any of the three pipelines and is assigned to a user
  2. A webhook sends the contact to Zapier
  3. Zapier creates the LaunchBay portal project and writes the project ID and portal URL to Airtable
  4. Zapier posts back to GoHighLevel
  5. After a 30-second wait the welcome SMS and email go out, a portal-sent tag is added and the team is notified internally
  6. A missing project ID, a missing Airtable record or a failed post raises its own alert
Key features
  • 3 workflows
  • 3 client paths
  • Error alerts on failure
  • Payment is the only trigger
Tools used
  • GoHighLevel
  • Zapier
  • LaunchBay
  • Airtable
Purpose

To close the gap between a client paying and being onboarded.
